decision.reason: The exact atlas contains real local signal, but its independent distortion gain is small relative to the incumbent semantic debt and its raw selected operands exceed their break-even outer-byte budget before cumulative interactions. Completing the same atlas on the current base is lower value than final-semantic-state construction and lattice-teacher solution compaction.
rearm_conditions: A materially improved final semantic Y1 becomes the exact incumbent and changes the G90 costates.
G98 cumulative replay plus STORE/DEFLATE realizes the eight listed operands below 65546 outer bytes while retaining enough exact whole-state distortion gain.
A downstream joint selector requests a specific later-stage batch because its conditional marginal value is measured rather than extrapolated.
next_primary_edges: G100 full-lattice teacher solution indexing and bounded identity compaction.
G94 V2 sparse semantic Y1 plus mutually exclusive G88-or-G95 conditional Y0 composition.
G95 exact pair-0 mechanism measurement followed by final-Y1 population refit only if warranted.
